detail.longDescription: 🔁 Same agent. Same settings. Same afternoon. Two red team runs scored 49.48 and 41.39, both graded D. Ayan Pahwa on measuring AI agent posture over time: scheduling the tests is trivial, reading them is not. Failures moved 30 to 29, but the conversations the judge could not assess went from 5 to 16. https://www. humanbound.ai/blog/continuous- security-testing-ai-agents-posture-over-time # AISecurity # AIAgents # RedTeaming
